name: Mobile (iOS) Application Testing (OWASP MASTG / MASVS)
description: Comprehensive security testing checklist for iOS applications based on OWASP Mobile Application Security Testing Guide (MASTG) and MASVS v2.0.

items.name: Testing Keychain Accessibility Attributes (kSecAttrAccessible)
items.how: Inspect iOS Keychain items to verify if sensitive tokens and credentials use appropriate kSecAttrAccessible flags (e.g. kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly instead of kSecAttrAccessibleAlways).
cases: Dump keychain items using Objection or keychain-dumper
Verify accessibility class for every stored credential or cryptographic key
Ensure 'ThisDeviceOnly' is used to prevent keychain items from syncing to iCloud unencrypted
items.recommendation: Store all sensitive data and tokens in iOS Keychain with kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly. Never use deprecated kSecAttrAccessibleAlways.

items.name: Testing Plists, NSUserDefaults, and CoreData for Sensitive Data
items.how: Inspect application sandbox plist files (Library/Preferences/*.plist), NSUserDefaults, and CoreData SQLite databases for unencrypted passwords, session tokens, or PII.
cases: Dump NSUserDefaults via Objection (ios nsuserdefaults get)
Inspect plist files in sandbox Library/Preferences/ using plutil
Examine CoreData SQLite files in Documents/ directory
items.expected: NSUserDefaults and plist files contain only non-sensitive configuration settings.
items.recommendation: Never store sensitive tokens or credentials in NSUserDefaults or plist files. Migrate all sensitive storage to the iOS Keychain.

items.name: Testing App Snapshots and Background Screen Masking
items.how: Verify if the iOS operating system takes unmasked screen snapshots when the application is sent to the background, storing sensitive account numbers or balances in Library/Caches/Snapshots/.
cases: Navigate to sensitive account screen and send app to background
Inspect /Library/Caches/Snapshots/ directory on device for unblurred screenshot image files
items.expected: Application applies privacy overlay / blur mask in applicationDidEnterBackground / sceneDidEnterBackground.
items.recommendation: Implement screen masking or blur view in sceneDidEnterBackground / applicationDidEnterBackground before snapshot is taken.

items.name: Testing App Transport Security (ATS) Configuration
items.how: Inspect Info.plist for NSAppTransportSecurity exceptions, specifically NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true or insecure NSExceptionAllowsInsecureHTTPLoads on broad domains.
cases: Verify whether NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is set to YES
Verify all network connections require TLS 1.3/1.2
items.expected: NSAppTransportSecurity is enforced without global NSAllowsArbitraryLoads bypasses.
items.recommendation: Avoid NSAllowsArbitraryLoads. If specific third-party domains require HTTP, limit exceptions strictly to those specific domains.

items.name: Testing SSL / TLS Certificate Pinning & Pinning Bypass
items.how: Verify if the app pins certificates or public keys (using TrustKit, URLSessionDelegate, or Alamofire) and test pinning bypass with Objection / Frida.
cases: Intercept traffic via Burp Suite proxy
Verify if app drops connection when untrusted CA is presented
Run Objection 'ios sslpinning disable' to test hookability
items.expected: SSL Pinning is implemented using SecTrustEvaluateWithError or TrustKit.
items.recommendation: Implement public key pinning with TrustKit or NSURLSessionDelegate and include backup pins.

items.name: Testing Binary Protections (PIE, ARC, Stack Canaries)
items.how: Analyze the compiled iOS Mach-O binary to verify that compiler exploit mitigation flags are enabled: Position Independent Executable (PIE), Automatic Reference Counting (ARC), and Stack Canaries.
cases: Check PIE flag: otool -hv {{BINARY_PATH}} | grep PIE
Check Stack Canary: otool -I -v {{BINARY_PATH}} | grep stack_chk_guard
items.recommendation: Enable all standard Xcode compiler protections in Build Settings: Generate Position-Dependent Code = NO, Enable Stack Protection = YES, Objective-C Automatic Reference Counting = YES.
items.command_template: otool -hv {{BINARY_PATH}} | grep PIE && otool -I -v {{BINARY_PATH}} | grep stack_chk_guard

items.name: Testing Jailbreak Detection and Anti-Debugging
items.how: Verify if the app detects jailbroken devices (checking /Applications/Cydia.app, /bin/sh, sandbox integrity, ptrace PT_DENY_ATTACH) and test bypass mechanisms using Frida / Objection.
cases: Run app on jailbroken iOS device and check behavior
Run Objection 'ios jailbreak disable' command to bypass detection
items.expected: App implements multi-layered jailbreak detection in native code and verifies device attestation.
items.recommendation: Implement multi-layered jailbreak checks and DeviceCheck / App Attest API for hardware-backed attestation.
